title: This Beijing Park Is Nearly 4x the Forbidden City | China Travel Expert
description:
You can walk a Beijing park that's nearly four times the size of the Forbidden City.

Beijing's Temple of Heaven (天坛) is far more than the round hall on the postcards. Its walled grounds cover about 2.7 million square metres — roughly 273 hectares — while the Forbidden City covers about 720,000 square metres (72 hectares). That makes the Temple of Heaven's park close to four times larger. Ming and Qing emperors came here to pray for a good harvest; today it is one of the city's great walking parks, with long cypress avenues leading to the altars.

🧭 Expert Tip: the park gates open around 6:30am while the main halls open a little later — arrive at opening to walk the long avenues almost empty.

北京天坛的园区约270公顷，差不多是故宫的四倍大——明清的皇帝来这里祈求丰收，如今是城里最好逆的公园之一。
